text.tspan: Mean income per month within each decile (before tax)1968 to 2024
The mean income per person per month within each decile (tenth of the population). Income here is measured
before taxes and benefits. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
